description1: In the shadow of the majestic Dolomites, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, the resilient spirit of mountain life takes shape. Here,
shaping daily life in countless ways.
description2: With vineyards flourishing at varying altitudes, South Tyrol is a land rooted in agriculture, and even more passionately, in winemaking.

section3.button2Description: The soils are calcareous, richly structured, with a good clay and organic substance content. It is on this slope that the Pinot Noir, Chardonnay and Pinot Grigio grapes are grown.
section3.button3Description: Castelvecchio is one of the highest areas in the municipality of Caldaro. Located at 700 metres above sea level, it stands out for its steep slopes, porphyry-rich soils and eastern exposure. Here, Pinot Bianco vineyards are cultivated for the Athesis Brut Metodo Classico,while the vineyards at higher altitudes give rise to the refined Athesis Pinot Bianco.
section3.button4Description: The strong temperature fluctuations, the breezes coming down from the Dolomite peaks, the sandy, well-drained soil. This is the ideal terrain to give life to the exceptional mineral and tropical notes of Müller Thurgau.

slides.title: our suppliers
slides.description: Thanks to our support, winegrowers can continue practising heroic viticulture, cultivating vineyards in the steepest areas of South Tyrol where machines can’t operate.

slides.title: The Masi
slides.description: We guarantee our winegrowers secure prospects in their Masi, the typical local South Tyrolean residences, which include the house and the surrounding land.

slides.title: 2030 Agenda
slides.description: We share with our winegrowers the commitment to treat the land according to the South Tyrolean Wine Consortium’s 2030 Agenda protocol.

slides.title: integrated pest management
slides.description: In order to contribute to environmental protection, we also require that the suppliers adhere to strict integrated pest management protocols.
